title: A high-risk sepsis subtype identified by regulated cell death signatures and MAD2L2 validation.

models.outcome_definition: 28-day mortality / survival (score was trained to identify high-risk RCD Cluster 3, then evaluated for 28-day mortality)
models.expression_scale_used: GSE65682 series-matrix values processed with GEOquery/limma (log2 array scale; highest-mean probe per gene); RCD.score medians ~17-23; standardized per 1 SD only for Cox HRs
models.cutoff: optimal cutpoint in GSE65682 (value not stated; 75 high / 404 low); GSE54514 used cohort median
models.reported_performance: GSE65682 (n=479, 114 deaths): 28-day mortality AUC 0.575 (optimism-corrected 0.577); KM high vs low p=0.00082; HR per SD 1.26 (1.05-1.50), age/sex-adjusted 1.23, attenuated after MARS adjustment (HR 0.99). Cluster 3 discrimination AUC 0.981. External GSE54514 Day-1 (n=35, 9 deaths): survival AUC 0.692 (0.473-0.912); no gain over APACHE II (AUC 0.776 vs 0.774).
models.source_location: Methods 'Candidate-gene prioritization and RCD.score construction'; Results + Fig. 4; coefficients in Supplementary Table S11 (Table3.xlsx) and 'Six_gene_formula' sheet (Table5.xlsx)

notes: Coefficients taken from supplementary files downloaded via Europe PMC (signatures/extraction/suppl/42723823/x/Table3.xlsx sheet S11 and Table5.xlsx sheet Six_gene_formula; the two agree). They are the LASSO coefficients of a 31-gene LASSO model classifying Cluster 3 vs other clusters (lambda=0.00379); only the 6 consensus genes (LASSO + top-30 RF + top-30 XGBoost) are used in the score, without refitting. All coefficients positive; 'risk' direction reflects higher score = Cluster 3 / higher mortality, not individually tested gene HRs. Underlying subtype model = consensus clustering of 4929 RCD compendium genes in 479 GSE65682 patients (4 clusters; Cluster 3 worst 28-day survival, log-rank p=0.034) - not recorded separately (gene set too large/compendium-defined, no centroids). GSE65682 healthy controls also used for expression comparisons. Authors note mortality discrimination of RCD.score is limited.
